globalBanner.description: Whether you're sourcing specialized medicines or expanding healthcare access overseas, Getmeds makes it simple, fast, secure, and reliable.

timeline.description: Tracking our continuous journey of growth, innovation, and unwavering commitment to expanding global healthcare access.

events.title: Established 2MG Inc.
events.description: Founded 2MG Inc., a pharmaceutical importer and distributor in the Philippines.

events.title: Launch of Getmeds Digital Platform
events.description: Introduced Getmeds, the first to pioneer a fully digital oncology care platform in the Philippines, featuring an innovative e-commerce platform and mobile app.

events.title: Established Getmeds HealthTech Pte. Ltd.
events.description: Extending its global reach and creating new opportunities for international expansion across Asia and beyond in Singapore.

events.title: Established Getmeds Philippines Inc.
events.description: A pharmaceutical company committed to redefining the Philippine healthcare landscape by providing high-quality, affordable generic medicines that are accessible to every Filipino.

events.title: Expansion to Pakistan
events.description: Opened an office in Pakistan in partnership with a trusted healthcare provider, supplying essential medicines and reaching more communities with reliable healthcare solutions.

milestones.title: Registered in Saint Kitts and Nevis
milestones.description: Strengthening its global presence and paving the way for further international growth in the Caribbean and beyond.

milestones.title: Opened Office in Vanuatu
milestones.description: Collaborated with the government to enhance medical support and introduce cancer awareness initiatives and life-saving healthcare solutions for the Pacific community.

milestones.title: First Specialty Cancer Pharmacy in the Pacific
milestones.description: Opened the Pacific's first specialty pharmacy dedicated to cancer medicines, providing localized access to life-saving treatments for patients in Vanuatu, Fiji, and across the Pacific region.

globalFootprint.heading: Our Global Footprint
